name: real__agent_checkpoints_manager_py___git_env
relabel_note: Gated keys: GIT_DIR and GIT_INDEX_FILE (both match live python). GIT_WORK_TREE is NOT gated: python runs _normalize_path = Path(v).expanduser().resolve(), which is filesystem- and cwd-dependent (relative paths, symlinks), so a pure C function cannot reproduce it and the value legitimately differs for anything but an already-absolute path. Left as a documented gap rather than a fixture that would have to be rigged.
